native_event_scenarios.title: Notification at each read/wait boundary
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Before mask change, after readiness check, immediately before syscall, during wait, and after wake; initial pipe read and follow with writer still open.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: No lost wakeup or stuck cancellation; flags consumed in the documented order.

native_event_scenarios.title: FIFO open without a writer
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Actual FIFO with no writer; cancellation before and during open; retry and shutdown.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Cancellation completes and releases resources; a worker backend must also prove bounded lifetime and join/reap.

native_event_scenarios.title: SIGINT with growing filters/search
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Barrier inside growth/replacement and around commit; repeated interrupts and rollback.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: No handler allocation/free; old or new valid filter is owned exactly once; terminal remains usable.

native_event_scenarios.title: SIGUSR1 queue and exhaustion
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Repeated commands before/during dispatch and at notification capacity.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Specified ordering/coalescing and exhaustion; no async command allocation or silent stranded work.

native_event_scenarios.title: Resize then numbered movement
native_event_scenarios.exercise: A real TIOCSWINSZ followed immediately by a numbered command, including same-size requests.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: One intended notification, exact command semantics and final geometry; no harness double-signal.

native_event_scenarios.title: Timer expiry and rearm
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Stale generations, rapid rearm/cancel and expiry around waits.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Old timer cannot affect a new operation; real-clock results supplement controlled-clock tests.

native_event_scenarios.title: Live input lifecycle
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Append, truncate, rotate/replace, open writer, short reads and unavailable backward data.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Defined retention and recovery; no stale position/storage; sparse seek beyond 4 GiB has separate coverage.

native_event_scenarios.title: Actual foreground stop/resume
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Foreground PTY SIGTSTP, terminal inspection while stopped, SIGCONT and immediate input.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Actual stopped state and restored terminal/session ownership, not a simulated signal-only test.

native_event_scenarios.title: Child/helper handoff and failure
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Editor/shell/pipe/URI controlled child stubs, exec/native failure, cleanup and secure restrictions.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Exact argv/bytes/effects/status; descriptors, signal masks and terminal modes restored.

native_event_scenarios.title: Termination and reusable resources
native_event_scenarios.exercise: SIGTERM/SIGHUP around startup, active I/O and teardown; repeated switch/cancel/drop.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Specified status and cleanup; no leaked FDs, children, workers or unbounded live allocations.

native_event_scenarios.title: Native callback and allocation faults
native_event_scenarios.exercise: Fail each logical reserve/commit, compile/free/callback/handoff boundary; inject EINTR/EAGAIN/short I/O/invalid FD.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Rollback or specified controlled failure; no panic/unwind crosses C; release pairs and init lengths remain valid.

native_event_scenarios.title: Inherited process state
native_event_scenarios.exercise: SIGPIPE ignore/default and supported inherited masks/dispositions, startup failure and child exec.
native_event_scenarios.oracle: Pager and children have the required state; setup failure restores prior dispositions/masks.

abi_matrix.scope: Declared Linux x86_64/glibc 2.41 reference ABI; matching headers, runtime, terminfo and GNU regex probes.
Observed baseline Linux x86_64/glibc 2.44 builder ABI, separately probed and tested; no inference for other glibc releases.
